pages.lesson:
LESSON: KUSOMA 9.2.1 KUSOMA KWA MAPANA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: AFYA YA AKILI Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Mapendekezo ya Shugh
Topic 9.2: Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua aina mbalimbali za matini ili kuchagua inayomvutia
2. kusoma matini aliyochagua ili kufaidika na ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua aina mbalimbali za matini ili kuchagua inayomvutia
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua aina mbalimbali za matini ili kuchagua inayomvutia. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kusoma matini aliyochagua ili kufaidika na ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa
   In simple words: practise until you can kusoma matini aliyochagua ili kufaidika na ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana.
4. Show that you can: kutambua aina mbalimbali za matini ili kuchagua inayomvutia

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 9.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua aina mbalimbali za matini ili kuchagua inayomvutia
2. kusoma matini aliyochagua ili kufaidika na ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
